result.instructions: Tools for Recommand, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices we sent this week failed to reach the buyer?"; "Show the unread documents in our inbox and mark the ones from the Acme order as read."; "Is the Peppol address 0208:0123456789 registered, and which document types does it accept?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Recommand data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run recommand_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run recommand_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run recommand_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. recommand_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: recommand_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List every company registered under the team, with its verification and Peppol registration status. Start here to get company ids. Not paginated. Recommand API: GET /api/v1/companies.

tools.name: recommand_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one company with its verification and Peppol registration status. Recommand API: GET /api/v1/companies/{companyId}.

companyId.description: Company id, for example c_01JQZ8X0M4T7RB6K9V2NDHW3PA (from recommand_list_companies).

tools.name: recommand_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List every label in the team. Use a label id with recommand_list_documents (labelId). Recommand API: GET /api/v1/labels.

tools.name: recommand_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List sent and received documents, one page at a time. Filter by company, direction, read status, dates, label or failed delivery (deliveryFailed true finds sends that need attention). Recommand API: GET /api/v1/documents.

companyId.description: One company id or a list.

anyOf.description: Company id, for example c_01JQZ8X0M4T7RB6K9V2NDHW3PA (from recommand_list_companies).

items.description: Company id, for example c_01JQZ8X0M4T7RB6K9V2NDHW3PA (from recommand_list_companies).

labelId.description: One label id or a list.

from.description: Created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

isUnread.description: true = unread only, false = read only.

deliveryFailed.description: true = only documents with at least one failed delivery.

excludeAttachments.description: true = leave attachments out of the parsed data.

tools.name: recommand_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one sent or received document with its parsed content and delivery status. Recommand API: GET /api/v1/documents/{documentId}.

documentId.description: Document id, for example doc_01JQZ8X0M4T7RB6K9V2NDHW3PA (from recommand_list_documents or recommand_get_inbox).

tools.name: recommand_get_inbox
tools.title: Get the inbox
tools.description: List incoming documents that are not marked as read yet. Process a document, then call recommand_mark_document_read so it leaves the inbox. Not paginated. Recommand API: GET /api/v1/inbox.

tools.name: recommand_verify_recipient
tools.title: Verify a Peppol recipient
tools.description: Look up a Peppol address in the directory before sending. Reports whether it is registered, the company name and the document types it accepts. isValid false means the lookup failed. Recommand API: POST /api/v1/verify.

peppolAddress.description: Peppol address as scheme:identifier, for example "0208:0123456789" (Belgian enterprise number).

includeEndpointDetails.description: true = add the endpoint details of each document type.

includeBusinessCard.description: true = add the company name and country from the business card.

tools.name: recommand_send_invoice
tools.title: Send an invoice
tools.description: SENDS A REAL INVOICE over the Peppol network, by email, or both. This cannot be undone, and each send counts toward the subscription usage. Check the buyer with recommand_verify_recipient first. Do NOT retry after a timeout: list the outgoing documents first, because the invoice may already be sent. If Peppol delivery fails and no email fallback applies, the call returns HTTP 422 and stores nothing. Recommand API: POST /api/v1/{companyId}/send.

companyId.description: The company that sends the invoice.

anyOf.description: Peppol address as scheme:identifier, for example "0208:0123456789" (Belgian enterprise number).

recipient.description: Buyer's Peppol address. Null sends by email only (then email.to is required).

email.description: Email delivery. Optional when a Peppol recipient is given.

when.description: "always" sends the email with the Peppol transmission. "on_peppol_failure" sends it only when Peppol delivery fails.

to.description: Email addresses. Required when recipient is null.

replyTo.description: Where replies go. Defaults to the seller's email address.

pdfGeneration.description: Attach a generated PDF of the invoice.

invoiceNumber.description: The invoice number the seller assigned.

dueDate.description: Defaults to one month after the issue date.

buyerReference.description: Buyer routing reference. Defaults to the invoice number.

street2.description: Extra address line, for example a suite.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example BE.

vatNumber.description: VAT number with its country prefix, for example BE0123456789.

enterpriseNumber.description: National registration number without the country prefix.

enterpriseNumberScheme.description: Scheme of enterpriseNumber, for example "0208" for a Belgian enterprise number.

seller.description: Defaults to the company that sends the invoice.

street2.description: Extra address line, for example a suite.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example BE.

vatNumber.description: VAT number with its country prefix, for example BE0123456789.

enterpriseNumber.description: National registration number without the country prefix.

enterpriseNumberScheme.description: Scheme of enterpriseNumber, for example "0208" for a Belgian enterprise number.

sellersId.description: The seller's item code or SKU.

unitCode.description: UN/ECE Rec 20 unit code. Default "C62" (one unit), "HUR" for hours.

netPriceAmount.description: Price of one unit, excluding VAT, for example "12.40".

percentage.description: VAT rate in percent, for example "21.00". Use "0.00" for zero rate.

invoice.description: Invoice in Peppol BIS 3 terms. Currency is EUR. Payment means, discounts and attachments are not part of this tool.

tools.name: recommand_mark_document_read
tools.title: Mark a document as read
tools.description: Mark a document as read, which removes it from the inbox. Pass read false to mark it unread again. Calling it again with the same value does no harm. Recommand API: POST /api/v1/documents/{documentId}/mark-as-read.

documentId.description: Document id, for example doc_01JQZ8X0M4T7RB6K9V2NDHW3PA (from recommand_list_documents or recommand_get_inbox).
